maddeler.e:
انملخت (form VII)
# اِنْمَلَخْتُ (inmalaḵtu) /in.ma.lax.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# اِنْمَلَخْتَ (inmalaḵta) /in.ma.lax.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# اِنْمَلَخْتِ (inmalaḵti) /in.ma.lax.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# اِنْمَلَخَتْ (inmalaḵat) /in.ma.la.xat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
